# Project instructions

UI is built with shadcn/ui (preset Nova, base-ui), Tailwind CSS v4 and Lucide React icons.

- Components live in `src/components/ui`. Add new ones with `npx shadcn@latest add <component>`; check `components.json` for aliases.
- Prefer existing shadcn components and variants over custom markup; use semantic color tokens only.
- Icons come from `lucide-react`; toasts use `sonner`.
- Follow the rules in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and the files in `.github/instructions/`.
